responsibility: Provides the x86 AVX-512CD intrinsic layer for conflict detection and leading-zero-count operations. This header defines the full-width wrappers for vpconflict, vplzcnt, and mask-broadcast instructions, exposing the AVX-512CD subset through GCC builtins and type aliases so front-end code can request conflict analysis and bit-counting vector semantics specific to this AVX-512 extension.
